title: Fewer than 40 recovered crashes

tellings.quote: Um I can't give you the official number because I know that number on a classified basis. I could say it's less than 40.
according to Eric Davis or how put off we have like 10 to 40 crafts in hangers across the United States
tellings.difference: Gives a range of 10 to 40 craft held in hangars, where the story says fewer than 40 crashes.
tellings.link_reason: Same classified count of recovered craft, credited to Eric Davis and Hal Puthoff.

as_told.title: 10 to 40 craft held in US hangars

related.note: Both give a count of the crashed craft the US holds. Davis says fewer than 40, which differs from Puthoff's 15, so one count could be right and the other wrong.

plain: The United States holds fewer than 40 crashed craft that are not of human make, according to Eric W. Davis, a physicist who has worked on Pentagon UFO studies, who says he knows the exact figure but it is classified. Michels later repeats it, crediting Davis or the physicist Hal Puthoff, as 10 to 40 craft kept in hangars across the country. If true, it would mean the government has quietly gathered dozens of such objects.
